t: On 30 December 1922 the Ukrainian SSR became one of the four founding republics of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.
The famine of 1932–1933 known as the Holodomor, caused by Stalin's regime's agricultural policies, cost an estimated 2.6 million to 10 million lives; whether it was genocide is disputed.
On 24 August 1991 the Supreme Soviet adopted the Act of Declaration of Independence of Ukraine, and on 1 December 92.3% of voters voted for independence.
dyk: Although it was part of the Soviet Union, the Ukrainian SSR was a founding member of the United Nations in 1945 and an elected member of the Security Council in 1948–1949 and 1984–1985.
ev: The Third All-Ukrainian Congress of Soviets ratified the Constitution of the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic in Kharkiv
The Ukrainian SSR joined the Russian, Byelorussian and Transcaucasian republics in founding the USSR
The Holodomor famine killed millions after forced collectivisation and grain requisitions
After the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, Eastern Galicia, Volhynia, Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina were attached to the republic
Nazi Germany occupied all of Soviet Ukraine and murdered about 1,554,000 Jews within Ukraine's present borders
The Ukrainian SSR became a founding member of the United Nations, and Carpathian Ruthenia was transferred to it
The Chernobyl disaster turned many Ukrainians against Soviet rule
The Supreme Soviet adopted the Act of Declaration of Independence of Ukraine, ending the Ukrainian SSR

f.founder: The Bolsheviks; the Third All-Ukrainian Congress of Soviets ratified its constitution in Kharkiv on 10 March 1919
f.predecessor: The Ukrainian People's Republic of Soviets and the Ukrainian Soviet Republic, against the Ukrainian People's Republic
